cases.title: Practicing: the lesson opens by picking up what was still off, in plain words with how long ago, no skill ID

rubric.reason: The opening "Eleven days ago you held one Blink pair, and the other pairs were still fading" picks up the record's earlier work in one plain sentence with how long ago, names no skill ID or field, and goes on with the lesson.
Blink's Opacity, Cut's Opacity, Seal as a precomp and "Eleven days ago" all match the snapshot's candidates, left_out and days_since_practiced values, and no layer, property or time is invented.

The short turn moves one idea, whether anything is meant to snap, and hands the learner "Is either one meant to snap instead?" to answer; the closing Seal sentence is only a brief left-out note that doesn't cancel that pending question.
